title: August 2026 Door Interaction Field — State Space, Hypersurface and Coupled Transformation Recovery
status: conversation-derived mathematical recovery; general interaction/interface model, not established new physics
provenance: Recovered from prior August 2026 conversations in which Door was formalized as a threshold hypersurface, interaction operator and map between structured state spaces. Exact notation may have been assistant-formalized while translating Tim's Door intuition; it must not be retroactively presented as a historical Tim-authored physics equation.
abstract: This record recovers an earlier Door formalism that treated the interface not merely as a symbolic threshold but as a typed interaction region between coupled subsystems. A system state was represented by a product space containing spacetime/configuration variables and internal fields, with a Door defined by a hypersurface H(X,t)=0 or H(X,t)>=0. Crossing activates an interaction Hamiltonian or transition generator that maps an incoming composite state T⊗A to an outgoing state T'⊗A'. The scientific content is the separation of three objects: the state manifold, the guard/hypersurface selecting when interaction occurs, and the coupling law determining what changes at the crossing. This architecture is useful in hybrid systems, scattering, open quantum systems, control interfaces and phase-boundary models. It does not imply that a theological Door is a literal fifth-dimensional portal. The record reconnects the earlier August equations to Potato Dynamics, Door/Handshake and the dimensional-transition programme while keeping its distinct interaction-field content.
research_question: Can Door events be modeled as localized interactions on a declared guard/hypersurface such that pre/post states, coupling strength, conserved quantities and transition probabilities are calculable and distinguishable from ordinary continuous evolution?

door_hypersurface.normal: n=grad H/|grad H| when H is differentiable and grad H != 0

door_hypersurface.transversality: A clean crossing requires dH/dt != 0 at the event; dH/dt=0 can indicate grazing/tangency and may need separate event logic.
door_hypersurface.meaning: Door opening is an event condition in state space, not an extra force.

interaction_generator.boundary: The quantum form applies only to a genuine quantum system; it is not a default equation for social, symbolic or psychological Doors.

The interaction term adds no predictive value beyond a smooth single-regime model.
